prompts.start: Use case: scientific-educational. Create the START / lowered-arm frame of a two-frame seal row exercise guide. Match the established PT guide style: charcoal studio background, gray anatomical male figure, black shorts and training shoes, realistic 3D medical-fitness rendering, subtle red target-muscle highlights, and clean unlabelled presentation. The exercise is a DUMBBELL SEAL ROW. One athletic adult gray anatomical figure lies FACE DOWN on a sturdy elevated FLAT black padded seal-row bench. The sternum, abdomen and pelvis stay supported by the pad. Both legs extend straight behind the hips along the long bench, stable and supported, not hanging down or standing on the floor. Neck stays neutral and head follows the spine, looking down. Arms hang long down on the two sides of the bench, elbows almost straight, each hand holding one black dumbbell below its shoulder in a neutral grip. Both dumbbells are clear of the floor, with ample vertical clearance under the elevated bench. Highlight latissimus dorsi and the mid-back around the shoulder blades in muted red; all other anatomy stays grayscale. Camera: rear-side three-quarter view, slightly elevated enough to clearly see the back and both shoulder blades; head at lower-left and legs receding toward upper-right. Show entire figure, entire bench, and both dumbbells, with comfortable margins in a portrait 3:4 composition. This is one single frame, not a panel or diptych. No text, labels, arrows, border, watermark or logo. No duplicated limbs. No movement blur. Chest must remain pressed to the pad, spine neutral, and equipment physically plausible. This same exact figure, bench, camera and light will be used for a subsequent end-frame edit.
prompts.end: Use case: precise-object-edit, scientific-educational exercise guide. Edit the provided seal-row START frame into its matching END / pulled-up frame. Change ONLY the arms, dumbbells and the associated natural scapular contraction. Preserve the exact same gray anatomical man, short dark hair, black shorts, shoes, full-length flat elevated black bench, charcoal studio background, portrait canvas, camera framing, lighting, surface textures and muted red highlighted back muscles. Keep the chest, sternum, abdomen and pelvis supported on the pad, legs extended and resting in exactly their same positions, head neutral and facing down. From the hanging-arm start pose, bend BOTH elbows and row both dumbbells upward beside the lower ribs, elbows travel backward close alongside the torso, elbows bent roughly 90 degrees, forearms nearly vertical and wrists straight in a neutral dumbbell grip. Both elbows end just above the torso/bench line, with no exaggerated shoulder shrug or overly high pull. Shoulder blades gently draw together; no torso lift, no lumbar arch and no head tilt. Both dumbbells must remain visible. Render a single still educational END frame. No text, arrows, labels, watermark or logo. Do not add or remove objects; no extra limbs.
